title: Three People Reportedly Died in Ruijin, China, Crash After Driver Activated Changan Driving Assistance
summary: Three occupants of a Changan Qiyuan car reportedly died when it hit a disabled truck in Ruijin, Jiangxi, China. Investigators said the driver activated intelligent driving assistance and removed his hands from the wheel. They identified his inattention and the truck driver's inadequate warnings as contributing causes. A defect in the assistance system was not established.
